author: April D
comment: Booked MV transport in Jan 2023 for a trip in December 2023.  No payment was required until November 2023 (1 month before travel).Transfer picked us up from Lyon airport and look us to Les Dues Alps.  We then had a return transfer a week later.Transfer was waiting for us when we got off the plane, the lady was new to the job/ route so did get lost but was very apologetic.  Minor detour, we got on the right road and made it safely to our hotel.The driver for the return leg was also on time and very helpful with loading bags.  The driver was a little fast on the return leg and both journeys at times phones were used but we got from A>B safely and without delay. Easy company to deal with and comfortable transfer so would re-book for any future trips.

author: Paul H
comment: We used MV Transport to transfer from the airport to the ski resort and whilst the MV driver was helpful with packing the luggage etc they drove far too fast, and far too close to other vehicles on the road.  They had their phone on their lap during the trip which they regularly used messaging etc whilst driving at high speeds.  On return we contacted the office, however their response was the following -"I have spoken with the concerned driver regarding those points. He told me that he did not make any phone call during the journey. We haven't received any complaints regarding his driving from other clients since the beginning of the season. We haven't received either any speeding ticket for his vehicle"As we cannot be assured of our future safety we cannot recommend or will use MV Transport again.

author: Simon G
comment: I can't recommend MV transfers highly enough. We had to amend our booking at very late notice and MV Transfers allowed us to do this despite having no obligation to help. Our transfer drivers were on time and helpful. We will definitely use MV Transfers again.

author: benedictduke
comment: Very happy with the service. Drivers were at the airport waiting to collect us on our arrival and also early in the morning to take us from the hotel for our departure. Drivers were friendly and help. Have used MV transport before and will use them again.

author: Bradkop1
comment: Leaving a review from the UK for MV Transport. I haven't actually had the transfers from Geneva airport to Saint Michel Valloire yet for me and two of my cycling friends which I have booked for July (it is currently June). I can send in a further review after the trip. So far the booking process and communication from Renuad at MV has been first class. On the MV website there are very easy and clear options to complete your booking and it also has a "live" diary to show availability. What I particularly liked was that MV didn't use cookies to hike up the price, as I visited their website several times before booking. Will return with a review of the actual services when we've had them.Further update (June 22) EasyJet have just cancelled our flights and we were forced to amend the transfer booking with MV. Very happy to report that MV amended the booking with clear communication and without any issue (amendment made 4 weeks before flights). Thank you MV.Further update (August 22) I have now returned back from the cycling trip to the French Alps. MV were amazing every step of the way! We were greeted at arrivals by James, who was very friendly and professional. We loaded the van with bike boxes and cases and James drove very carefully to our destination. He was also back to pick us up at the end of the trip and was perfectly on time. Cannot recomend MV enough and will definitely be using any time I am in the Alps again.

author: carolyn l
comment: We used this company for the first time this year, and found them to be first class,the transfer arrived on time, the driver was helpful and friendly, after our experience we will now he using them every time.

author: Andy J
comment: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!                     DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY I requested a shared transfer/return for 95 Euros and received a quotation valid for 48 hrs.The next day I then received this from them: "We can only guarantee you this shared transfer for those dates and times if you book for 3 persons at least (or 4 passengers on Saturdays)". My transfer is on a Saturday so fare now 380 Euros. A quotation commits them to provide a service at a certain price, So applied to book that to then find the Saturday was now not available,   Have requested details of Company Director so I can complain - no response.

author: Andrew
comment: Have just had a fabulous week in Flaine. We had trouble getting a reasonably pieced transfer from Geneva. Ended up finding MVtransport buried in an internet. They were excellent, well priced, on time and communicated well including changing pick up time to allow us more time to navigate Geneva airport. Can’t recommend them enough.

author: Kerri & Shaun Debnam
comment: Found MV Transport to be one of the cheapest quotes, fraction of the price I was going to pay another company for multi drop transfer, MV could do a private one!  Extremely efficient, waiting for us outside arrivals and smooth journey to our destination in the mountains. Then again on our return transfer, on time and another smooth journey!

author: positivetravel
comment: We  were a small group of friends  and family that booked MV transport from Lyon to Le Menuire for March 2020Since the pandemic has already started, our flights were cancelled by the airline company, and our country imposed mandatory quarantine upon return, therefore we had to cancel a few days before the trip.Our hotel refunded full payment after 18 month!ESF refunded the money!All airlines that cancelled flights refunded!All car companies rented by our friends refunded!Even Alp 2 Alp a similar transport company refunded 90% of the payment!!!!!!!Only MV transport insisted on sticking to the original contract to refund only 25% of the full payment, or get a voucher18 month later, during which  most of the time we  couldn't even travel to France nor ski,  we asked for full refund according to the French law. The first reaction was refusal, than we asked again and they agreed to 50% refund claiming that they are not subjected to the same law as other tourist services. Since it was  a half of 1210 EUR we  didn't have the energy to argue further and just took the money.Yet, as I wrote,  all other companies refunded most or all of the money, and since the French ski resorts continued to work during that week, so they could have alternative customers. We feel it was unfair to punish us for these un expected circumstances, when most companies made an effort to give good service.Soo I would recommend picking a transfer company that has more respect and consideration for customers.
